task: photo-editing flagship 7 buildable item: a directional (Markesteijn-style) X-Trans demosaic in place of bilinear, measured against LibRaw on the X-E1 and X-E2 RAFs

errors.what: First directional version mirror-padded the CFA, which breaks the 6x6 phase at the frame edge (wrong colours on the outer 2-3 px)
errors.fix: phase-preserving fold padding by whole periods; caught by the flat-field test

errors.what: float32 rewrite cast the input before saving it, so sensels lost their exact values
errors.fix: keep a float64 copy for the final own-value write; caught by test_keeps_each_sensels_own_value

errors.what: Assumed half size would hide the demosaic difference and coded a bilinear-at-half-size rule before measuring
errors.fix: measured (directional wins 1.1-13.4 dB at half size), reverted the rule

errors.what: CI lint (mypy 1.19.1) rejected passing a dict of mixed float/int settings as **kw to _directional_piece
errors.fix: explicit keyword arguments; ruff 0.15.8 and mypy 1.19.1 (CI's pins) clean locally

doc_friction.issue: The cloud-session note says 'a bare python3 often lacks pytest/numpy'; run_venture_tests.py then passes with 8 numpy tests skipped, so a numpy-only feature can look green while its tests never ran. I ran the suite again under a numpy venv (1092 OK); the CI note could say which interpreter the venture job uses.

deviations.why: Repository convention is that both engines give the same bytes; the directional demosaic is numpy-only (a pure-Python version would take minutes per frame)
deviations.did: auto = directional only on the numpy engine; the pure engine keeps bilinear with a note and refuses an explicit 'directional'; engine-agreement tests name demosaic='bilinear'
deviations.result: tests green on both interpreters; documented in README and eval

goal: Deepen flagship 7 (photo-editing) with an engineering problem: X-Trans demosaic quality
notes: Known truth: X-E1 binned 36.60 dB (bilinear 34.83, LibRaw 1-pass 37.48, 3-pass 39.28); X-E2 held out 47.88 (41.95, 46.45, 49.89); synthetic sheet 33.51 (20.25, 25.89, 39.37). Speed 21 s -> 7-8.5 s per 16 MP frame after profiling (pad once, gathers, separable box, float32, median network); memory 3.5 -> 2.1 GB. Verification: run_venture_tests.py photo-editing ok (system python, 130 s, 8 numpy tests skipped); full tests dir under a numpy 2.4 venv with PYTHONPATH=src: 1092 tests OK (7 skipped). Eval rows regenerated by the tool itself (half-size rows included), equal to the earlier run to the third decimal. Not done: LibRaw 3-pass quality, noisy known truth for the real-frame luma gap, C path. venture-preflight photo-editing: clean on rerun (first run failed platform/ci/test_check_row_spread.py on a vanished temp dir under ventures/, passes alone: a race, not this diff).
